appLanguage.title: Choose your language
appLanguage.subtitle: You can change this later in Profile.

spokenLanguage.title: Expected spoken language
spokenLanguage.subtitle: Set the language you usually speak during recordings. You can override this per project or session.
spokenLanguage.modeAutoHelp: Language will be detected in future transcription milestones.
spokenLanguage.modeMultipleHelp: Choose two or more expected languages to support code-switching.

consent.title: Recording responsibly
consent.body: Only record when you have permission. Local laws vary. Project Recall always shows an active recording indicator and a foreground notification while recording.

privacy.title: Your data is yours
privacy.bulletStorage: Files stay on this device until you sync.
privacy.bulletCloud: Cloud copies are stored in a private, encrypted bucket only you can access.
privacy.bulletAi: No AI processing runs in this milestone.

workspace.title: Create your workspace
workspace.subtitle: This is your personal workspace. You can add teammates in a future release.
